core: Natives place 之后 after an event or action to say 'after that'; it is more flexible than 以后 and can refer to a specific one-time sequence, not just the distant future. Learners often overuse it for vague future time, where 以后 sounds more natural.

sentences.zh: 我们晚饭之后去散散步吧。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men wǎn fàn zhī hòu qù sàn sàn bù ba
sentences.en: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
sentences.why: A friend suggesting a low-key plan for this evening, using 之后 to mark the clear sequence between eating and walking.
sentences.tip: The ba at the end makes it a friendly suggestion, not a command.

sentences.zh: 会议之后，我们再讨论这个细节。
sentences.pinyin: huì yì zhī hòu, wǒ men zài tǎo lùn zhè ge xì jié
sentences.en: We'll discuss this detail further after the meeting.
sentences.why: A colleague telling you to postpone a small conversation until the scheduled meeting is over, so no time is wasted now.
sentences.tip: Slightly more polite than saying 等会儿; it references a fixed event.

sentences.zh: 孩子吃完药之后就睡着了。
sentences.pinyin: hái zi chī wán yào zhī hòu jiù shuì zháo le
sentences.en: The kid fell asleep right after taking the medicine.
sentences.why: A parent updating another family member about the child's condition, linking two events that happened one after the other.
sentences.tip: Pattern: action + 完 + object + 之后 = right after finishing that action.

sentences.situation: At a café · to a friend
sentences.zh: 毕业之后，我就来了中国。
sentences.pinyin: bì yè zhī hòu, wǒ jiù lái le zhōng guó
sentences.en: I came to China right after I graduated.
sentences.why: Telling your personal backstory, marking graduation as the starting point for your move to China.
sentences.tip: Pairing 之后 with 就 emphasizes that the next action happened immediately.

sentences.zh: 您开完会之后，能帮我看一下这份合同吗？
sentences.pinyin: nín kāi wán huì zhī hòu, néng bāng wǒ kàn yī xià zhè fèn hé tóng ma
sentences.en: After you finish your meeting, could you look over this contract for me?
sentences.why: An employee asking for a favor without interrupting the boss mid-meeting, showing awareness of the boss's schedule.
sentences.tip: Using néng ... ma makes the request soft; do not say 你开完会之后 you must look.

sentences.zh: 别担心，刚到新公司的头几个月之后就好了。
sentences.pinyin: bié dān xīn, gāng dào xīn gōng sī de tóu jǐ ge yuè zhī hòu jiù hǎo le
sentences.en: Don't worry, things will get better after the first few months at the new company.
sentences.why: Comforting a friend who is stressed about their new job, framing the hard period as temporary.
sentences.tip: The phrase jiù hǎo le is the standard comforting phrase for 'it'll get better'.

sentences.zh: 春节假期之后，我们将执行新的考勤制度。
sentences.pinyin: chūn jié jià qī zhī hòu, wǒ men jiāng zhí xíng xīn de kǎo qín zhì dù
sentences.en: After the Spring Festival holiday, we will implement the new attendance policy.
sentences.why: A formal written announcement to all staff, stating exactly when a new rule takes effect.
sentences.tip: Written notices prefer 之后 over 以后 for a precise start date.

sentences.situation: At a restaurant · to the waiter
sentences.zh: 我们吃完主菜之后再点甜品，可以吗？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men chī wán zhǔ cài zhī hòu zài diǎn tián pǐn, kě yǐ ma
sentences.en: Can we order dessert after we finish the main course?
sentences.why: Diners telling the waiter they don't want dessert yet, to avoid ordering too much food at once.
sentences.tip: kě yǐ ma softens the request; it sounds more natural than 我们现在不点.

sentences.zh: 我下班之后直接过去，大概七点半能到，你先点喝的吧。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xià bān zhī hòu zhí jiē guò qù, dà gài qī diǎn bàn néng dào, nǐ xiān diǎn hē de ba
sentences.en: I'll head straight over after work, probably arrive around 7:30, you go ahead and order drinks first.
sentences.why: Coordinating a meetup with a friend, letting them know they don't need to wait or order on your account.
sentences.tip: Native speech drops time markers like 今天 in casual messages; the context makes it obvious.

sentences.situation: At work · to a senior colleague
sentences.zh: 这个项目上线之后，后续的维护工作还得麻烦你们多费心。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge xiàng mù shàng xiàn zhī hòu, hòu xù de wéi hù gōng zuò hái děi má fan nǐ men duō fèi xīn
sentences.en: After this project goes live, we'll still have to trouble you all to take care of the ongoing maintenance.
sentences.why: A project lead politely asking the technical team for continued support after launch, using polite humble phrasing.
sentences.tip: má fan nǐ men duō fèi xīn is a standard polite work phrase for asking for extra help.

quiz.prompt: Tell your friend you will call them after you finish work today.
quiz.answer: 我下班之后给你打电话。
quiz.explain: Using 之后 right after the action 下班 naturally marks the time you will call.

quiz.prompt: Tell your classmate that you will go to the library after breakfast.
quiz.answer: 我吃完早饭之后去图书馆。
accept: 早饭之后我就去图书馆。
吃完早饭之后我要去图书馆。
quiz.explain: Placing 之后 after the meal event creates a clear, natural sequence between eating and studying.

quiz.prompt: Politely ask your manager to review your report after the morning meeting, so you do not interrupt them now.
quiz.answer: 您开完早会之后，能帮我看一下这份报告吗？
accept: 早会之后，麻烦您帮我看看这份报告可以吗？
等您开完早会之后，想请您帮忙看一下这份报告。
quiz.explain: Referencing the fixed meeting event with polite néng ... ma sounds considerate and professional.

quiz.prompt: Comfort your friend who is nervous about moving to a new city: tell them things will feel normal after the first month.
quiz.answer: 别担心，到新城市头一个月之后就慢慢习惯了。
accept: 别紧张，刚来一个月之后就好了。
刚开始不适应，过一个月之后就习惯了。
quiz.explain: Framing the hard adjustment period as temporary with 之后 jiù ... is the standard comforting pattern.

quiz.prompt: 你的朋友问你：「周末有什么安排？」 你回答说：周六上午要在家打扫，打扫完之后下午去逛商场。
quiz.answer: 周六上午我先在家打扫卫生，打扫完之后下午去逛商场。
accept: 周六上午在家收拾，收拾完之后下午去商场逛逛。
周六上午打扫屋子，之后下午跟朋友去逛商场。
quiz.explain: Linking the two weekend plans with 之后 shows a natural, sequential schedule.

quiz.prompt: 同事问你：「新的考勤制度什么时候开始用？」 你回答说：春节假期结束之后，大家就要按照新制度打卡了。
quiz.answer: 春节假期之后，我们就要执行新的考勤制度了。
accept: 春节假期结束之后，新考勤制度就正式开始了。
放完春节假期之后，大家就要按新的考勤制度来了。
quiz.explain: Stating the exact starting event for a new rule with 之后 is how official workplace announcements are spoken.
